One of America's 50 best restaurants

In 2024 The New York Times put Simply South on its list of the best restaurants in the country. Here's what the press has said since.

  • The New York Times America's Best Restaurants, 2024Simply South named to the list for its South Indian vegetarian cooking.
  • WFAA One of the 50 best restaurants in the U.S.Coverage of the Irving restaurant's place on the Times list.
  • Dallas Observer An Irving restaurant makes the Times' best 50On the Irving kitchen's national recognition.
  • The Dallas Morning News Irving restaurant named to the NYT 50 bestSeptember 2024.
  • Dallas Innovates Why the Times put Simply South on its 2024 listA look at what earned the recognition.
  • Lone Star Live Texas restaurants winning over dinersOctober 2024. Simply South alongside two other Texas kitchens.
  • KISS FM El Paso Three Texas restaurants among the best in the U.S.Texas's showing on the Times list.
  • CultureMap Dallas Simply South named a New York Times favoriteOn the Irving restaurant's selection.
